title: DSP-CM44 - Communication Module/RS485

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Internal communication with a converter of VIP Series by RS232 (DSP-VIP-PL/PM , DSP-VIP-RL/RTL, RM/RTM)
External communication with a Master(PC, PLC) through 485/422 as a RTU,Modbus
Able to communicate with PC directly through a protocol converter of 485 < > USB/232
Convenient engagement for a termination resistance of extreme end unit by DIP SW
Possible to meet 485 or 422 by the DIP SW selection
Convenient wiring connection through RJ45 or 10P screw terminal
– RJ45 : diagnostic communication test of each unit through "Samdsp"
– Screw terminal : actual wiring connecion in installed field

your_notes: โมดูลสื่อสาร RS485 สำหรับรุ่น RTM
